title: Bài kiểm tra tiếng Anh đầu vào
description: Ước lượng trình độ CEFR ban đầu (A1-C1) cho 3 kỹ năng: Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading. Listening/Speaking sẽ test riêng qua hội thoại giọng nói khi Trà Đình có STT/TTS.
instructions: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu. Không cần vội — làm hết khả năng, câu khó dần về cuối là bình thường.

reading.passage: Remote work has changed how many companies think about office space. A decade ago, most businesses assumed that employees needed to be physically present to collaborate effectively. Today, that assumption is being questioned. Some companies have shrunk their offices dramatically, arguing that video calls and shared documents can replace most in-person meetings. Others have taken the opposite approach, investing heavily in office spaces designed to make the commute worthwhile — think gyms, free meals, and quiet pods for focused work. Critics of remote work point to a decline in spontaneous conversation, the kind that happens when two colleagues bump into each other near the coffee machine and end up solving a problem neither had scheduled time to discuss. Supporters counter that this romanticizes a workplace culture that was never as productive as nostalgia suggests, and that employees who no longer waste hours commuting report higher job satisfaction. The debate is unlikely to be settled soon, partly because the answer may simply depend on the type of work being done.

questions.question: According to the passage, what did most companies assume a decade ago?
options: Physical presence was necessary for effective collaboration
Video calls were more productive than meetings

questions.question: Why have some companies invested in gyms and free meals?
options: To make commuting to the office feel worthwhile
Because employees demanded it in a survey

questions.question: What do critics of remote work say is lost?
What is the supporters' counterargument, according to the passage?
options: Office culture was never as productive as people remember it being
Remote work is always more productive
Commuting is good for employee health
Spontaneous conversations rarely lead to solutions

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about resolving this debate?
options: It will be resolved once remote work becomes standard everywhere
The answer may depend on the type of work involved
Most companies have already reached a consensus
The debate is purely about cost, not culture

writing.prompt: Viết đoạn văn 100-150 từ (tiếng Anh) trả lời: "Do you think remote work makes people more or less productive? Give at least one reason."
writing.note: Không có đáp án cố định — chấm bằng AI (Groq LLM) dựa trên tiêu chí: ngữ pháp, từ vựng, mạch lạc, độ dài đủ yêu cầu. Xem gợi ý rubric bên dưới.

scoring.note: grammarVocabulary thực chất trộn 2 kỹ năng (grammar + vocabulary) vì khó tách hoàn toàn ở dạng trắc nghiệm. Tạm thời dùng CHUNG 1 điểm CEFR cho cả 2 skillScores (skill=GRAMMAR và skill=VOCABULARY) — phân tách chính xác hơn sẽ dựa vào biểu hiện thực tế trong hội thoại luyện tập sau này, không chỉ bài test 1 lần.
